title: Student Success Plan
description: A comprehensive plan to improve study habits, time management, and academic performance

goals.title: Improve Study Consistency
goals.description: Study for at least 2 hours every weekday

goals.title: Complete Assignments Early
goals.description: Submit all assignments at least 1 day before deadline

goals.title: Master Note-Taking
goals.description: Develop effective note-taking system for all subjects

habits.title: Daily Study Session
habits.description: Study for at least 2 hours every weekday

habits.title: Review Notes
habits.description: Review and organize notes from the day

habits.title: Prepare Next Day
habits.description: Pack bag and prepare materials for next day

habits.title: Weekly Review
habits.description: Review all subjects and plan for upcoming week

tasks.title: Create Study Schedule
tasks.description: Plan study times for each subject

tasks.title: Organize Study Space
tasks.description: Set up a dedicated study area

tasks.title: Identify Weak Subjects
tasks.description: List subjects that need extra attention

tasks.title: Find Study Resources
tasks.description: Collect textbooks, online resources, and videos

warnings: Take regular breaks to avoid burnout
Get enough sleep for better memory retention
Ask teachers for help when needed
fallback_message: I found a great student success template! Let me set you up with a plan to improve your study habits and academic performance.
